recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to external canonical ValueSet URL handling should be made in the IG Publisher/tools package unless current core ImplementationGuide definitions or narrative become misleading.
issue_request: FHIR-12456 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-core change request about the IG Publisher rejecting ValueSet resources whose canonical URLs did not match the importing IG's canonical base, with comments clarifying that value sets from another guide should normally be referenced through the owning IG rather than republished.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentions FHIR-12456. Historical in-tree IG Publisher commits shortly after the issue was filed changed definitions zip generation so importing IGs could use current-version resource definitions and fixed DSTU2 ValueSet handling, matching the Jira comment that the issue had been fixed via definitions-file/dependency handling.
additional_context: ImplementationGuide is active in source/fhir.ini. Current ImplementationGuide.dependsOn describes IGs using value sets and profiles from other IGs, current authoring guidance says resources in dependency packages are not included in the importing package, and ImplementationGuide.definition.parameter is tool-defined/extensible. The old in-tree IG Publisher was removed when it moved to Maven. FHIR-13131, the adjacent special-URL exception issue for included external ValueSet canonical URLs, is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The current core specification already conveys the dependency model needed for value sets owned by another IG, and any remaining executable IG Publisher behavior belongs to external publisher/tools code rather than this core checkout.

related_jiras.note: Similar Published/Persuasive issue for intentionally included external ValueSet canonical URLs; already audited on the combined branch by commit 00ad14155de309fedd6229fba51eea20e8ea1114, so no duplicate decision was made.
